caption: The drawing depicts a single pink dress, centered on a plain, off-white background. The dress has a fitted bodice with a ruffled, wide neckline and short puffed sleeves. The skirt is long, flowing, and gathered at several points, creating a slight drape and volume. Two thin, long ribbons, each ending in a decorative rosette, hang from the waistline down the front of the dress. There is a gathered band and a ruffled hem at the bottom of the skirt, both also rendered in pink. The entire dress is illustrated with pink tones, with darker pink lines used to give detail and texture to the fabric, creating the appearance of folds, shadows, and embellishments. No background elements, human figures, or additional objects are present, and the drawing is signed “R. Romano” near the bottom right corner.
title: Dress
